load_urdf_table: load a URDF table model into the pybullet simulation environment at a specified position
load_urdf_widowx_arm: load a WidowX robotic arm URDF into pybullet with a fixed base configuration
reset_base_position_and_orientation: reset the position and quaternion orientation of a loaded robot body in the simulation
step_simulation_loop: run a continuous simulation loop that steps physics and captures camera images each frame
get_camera_image: capture a camera image from the debug visualizer using the current view and projection matrices
